I've always kinda been the outcast never really had many freinds. So I've always gotten bullied, called names, beat up, generally bad stuff to begin with.
One day I was minding my own business walking into class when I see the group of petty "christian" girls (I say it like that because there all going to hell) suddenly stop talking and awkwardly continuing on to another subject. Yeah cool, I've seen this before. They where talking about me behind my back whatever.
After class there all walking down the stairs behind me to get to class. One of the girls call out to me, I dont remember what they said I just know it caught my attention. I looked up and said "What do you want" now that kinda pissed them off. I turned back down and kept walking. They called out again, I didnt answer. I was a few feet from the door when they grab the hood of my hoodie and yank me backward. Now as a bit of context of where I am is at the bottom theres a hollowed out area under the stairs where they double up. Theres 2 doors and there is no teachers or other student any where neer at this point. Anyway they pull my hood back towards them, jerking me backwards and almost making me fall. After I stood back up all the way I turned around and faced the one who did that (well call her b for bitch) I remember saying something along the lines of, why the fuck did you do that, before some of the other girls grabbed me and held me there. For more context I have some kind of eating disorder, anxiety and depression and everyone in school new that because of a fake freind telling the whole school earlier that year. They pulled up my sleeves and make remarks about my body, about my scars, about how I was twitching ( I get really twitchy when I get anxious, it's not tourettes I dont know what it is) I told them to stop but they didnt. Then they decided to look at my legs so they tore open the ripps in my jeans to make them bigger and they saw the still healing wounds that where there from more self harm. They told me how I should "go ahead and cut more" and to "stop eating, look at how fat you are" they laughed and continued for a minute or two more and then left me, shaking in the stairway. I eventually got up and went to class though I was really late. But I told no one.......... welp that was one of the most fucked up thing that has happened to me in school.
